subject: Immediate pause on new requisitions — guidance and reallocation plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Immediate pause on new requisitions — guidance and next steps

Team,

Effective immediately, please pause posting any new requisitions to Workday and halt external sourcing for new roles until Monday, 2026-05-16. This is a temporary company-wide pause driven by a near-term cash forecast update — we need to conserve runway while we finalize Q2 commit targets.

Key points: 
- New req postings: paused (no exceptions) until 2026-05-16.
- Offers already extended: can be progressed only after an expedited approval if the total on-target comp (OTC) is above $190k for ICs or $240k for managers.
- Any role where the hiring manager proposes a headcount reallocation (e.g., shifting a design headcount to infra) should submit a short business-justification doc and the proposed org chart change to HR (cc: me).
- Recruiting and hiring managers: hold all scheduling for new candidate screens (unless a previously scheduled on-site is time-sensitive — flag to me and Laura).

Laura, please publish the compensation band summary and an approval checklist to the HR portal and share guidance on expedited approvals. Nikhil — I know you have several active reqs; please put together a prioritization note (which roles to keep in-flight, which to pause, and any headcount redeployment asks).

I expect a short summary from each hiring manager by EOD Monday 2026-05-04. We'll decide next steps and exceptions at that review.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: May_headcount_snapshot.xlsx]

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.recruiter@talentbridge.io
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Immediate pause on new requisitions — guidance and next steps

Thanks Vivek — noted. A few clarifying points from Eng/:

1) Open offers in final stage: we have two verbal offers in flight that are handshake-stage:
   - L4 SWE (req 4321) — candidate Jane Doe (external) — offer package being prepared by Recruiter (Sara). OTC expected ~ $185k base + equity; below the $190k threshold but close.
   - Senior Product Designer (req 4280) — offer pending comp band confirmation; OTC estimate ~$150–160k.

2) Reallocation proposal: I would like to propose repurposing the UX Designer headcount (req 4280) into an SRE/Infra IC (L3) to support our new latency-focused serving stack work. The rationale: immediate operational risk on infra, lower downstream cost if we reduce triage time. I will draft the short business justification and updated org chart.

3) Compensation bands: can Laura confirm whether the L4 SWE OTC at $185k still requires approval? Also—if we convert the UX headcount to an L3 infra role, will the comp band change and require a new approval?

Action items I will take:
- Pause external posting for the two open reqs until we get confirmation (I've asked Sara to halt active outreach for other candidates).
- Attach candidate summaries and the draft justification for reallocation to this thread for review.

Sara — I've cc'd you so you can hold on offer paperwork for Jane until Laura confirms band.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

[attachment: Candidate_Summary_JaneDoe.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Immediate pause on new requisitions — guidance and next steps

Thanks Vivek and Nikhil — posting guidance and quick answers below. I also attached the compensation bands and the May headcount snapshot.

- Comp bands: the L4 SWE OTC at $185k is below the expedited-approval threshold. You can proceed with the standard offer checklist. If equity components or signing bonuses push the total above $190k, submit the Offer Approval Form (attached) for expedited review.

- Role conversions (headcount repurposing): HR will accept a one-page business justification and a simple org-chart delta. Once submitted we fast-track to Finance for a headcount reallocation decision (target turnaround 72 business hours if documentation is complete). If Nikhil wants to convert the UX req to an L3 Infra IC, please include the expected impact metrics (reduced mean time to mitigate, SLA improvements, or projected cost reductions from fewer incidents).

- Candidate offers already negotiated: for candidates with signed verbal offers and start dates within 30 days, we will treat each case individually — please include start date and current offer economics so we can prioritize approvals.

Quick housekeeping: I've uploaded CompBands_Q2_v2.pdf and May_headcount_snapshot.xlsx to the HR drive and linked the Workday req (see links). The Offer_approval_form-1234.pdf is attached to this message for any expedited submissions.

Laura Bennett
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: CompBands_Q2_v2.pdf]
[attachment: Offer_approval_form-1234.pdf]

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.recruiter@talentbridge.io, jane.doe@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Immediate pause on new requisitions — guidance and next steps

Thanks — plan below and requests for approvals: 

Summary of decisions (for my team):
- Pause new postings: implemented. All active sourcing paused, external job ads pulled.
- Offers in flight: Jane Doe (L4 SWE) — proceed with standard checklist (OTC $185k). Sara, please prepare the formal offer but do not send until I confirm final comp paperwork; Laura confirmed no expedited approval required at $185k.
- Senior Product Designer (req 4280): hold. I will submit a reallocation request to convert req 4280 (UX Senior Product Designer) into one L3 Infra IC. Business justification attached — it outlines the infra gaps, estimated incident reduction (40% fewer Sev2 escalations for serving), and the proposed org chart.

Requests to HR/Finance:
1) Fast-track the reallocation review for req 4280 — submitted justification attached. Target: decision by 2026-05-07 to avoid delaying the infra roadmap.
2) If approved, allow a one-time exception to move the headcount without increasing overall budgeted HC for Eng for Q2.

I will follow up with the org chart PDF and a short 1-slide justification in the Drive link. If we get approval by Friday, I will instruct Sara to close out outreach for the designer role and open a new L3 infra req immediately (per Workday link above).

Thanks everyone — I appreciate the quick turnaround.

Nikhil
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

[attachment: Realloc_justification_req4280.pdf]
